subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.mp4@isobmff` is this plugin's own self-contained ISOBMFF MP4 container file — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, set-ftyp, insert-track, remove-track, set-track-dimensions, set-track-codec, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
